facets.description: Javadoc for void requireView() (ClientPermissionEvaluator.java lines 95-98) says 'Returns true if canView() returns true'. It should say it throws ForbiddenException when canView() returns false.

Javadoc for void requireViewClientScopes() (ClientPermissionEvaluator.java lines 100-103) says 'Returns true if canViewClientScopes() returns true'. It should say it throws ForbiddenException when canViewClientScopes() returns false.
